title: Ali akbar ka janaza
body:
umme laila ali akbar ka janaza aaya
khoon may dooba hua laal ka sehra aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema sughra ka khat pad kar ye bole shabbir
naam tere ali akbar khat e sughra aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
baith kar sochti rehti thi ye sughra ghar may
mere bhai ka na shaadi ka bulawa aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
le to aaye shah e deen laash e jawan qaime tak
aisa lagta tha ke shabbir ka laasha aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ne athara baras paala tha us se poocho
kis tarha barchi may akbar ka kaleja aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
naujawan laal ke seene se nikaali barchi
waqt mazloom musafir pe ye kaisa aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ko armaan tha shadi ka wo maa kya karti
jis ki taqdeer may ta umr tadapna aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab na akbar hai na abbas na koi nasir
ay zafar ye lab e shabbir pe nauha aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
author: Zafar Abbas
